notes_for_editor: Thin record: the FFLOS register page is the only Low Knob-specific source. Two web searches, including one for a 1908 Pennsylvania forestry report, found no Low Knob-specific source; the 1908 lookout-station text they surfaced is from Maine and is not used. A TopoQuest Low Knob summit in Pike County (about 1,991 ft) is not clearly this tower site, so it is not used. The High Knob fire tower nearby is a different, still-active structure on Delaware State Forest land; not used. The register gives no coordinates, so the brief's point cannot be checked. The firelookout.org Pennsylvania list returned 404 in the cache. No build date, staffing, fires or site description found. Source 2 is a general statewide remark, not about this tower. Checked 2026-10-10: the story no longer glosses 'bald tower' (the register does not define the term), and the statewide remark is paraphrased rather than quoted.
